info.name: Superpower
info.description: Superpower (superpower.com) is a consumer preventive-health and longevity membership. As of the catalog date it publishes no public, partner, or developer API: there is no developer portal, API reference, authentication scheme, or set of endpoints. This collection is intentionally minimal and contains no callable API operations; it only links to the public marketing site. No endpoints have been fabricated.

request.description: Public marketing and member site. Not a documented API endpoint; included only as a reference because Superpower does not publish a developer API.
